description: This file is a code-behind for the TheorySet.aspx page in an online examination system. It handles page events and user interactions for managing theory questions, including adding questions, setting up exams, navigating between pages, and dynamically populating course options based on semester selection.

classes.name: TheorySet
classes.description: Partial class representing the code-behind for the TheorySet.aspx page, managing user interactions and data operations related to theory questions in the online exam system.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the initial load event of the page, currently with commented-out code related to session management.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Transfers user to the AdminPanel page when the 'Home' button is clicked.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Transfers user to the AdminQueue page when the 'Profile' button is clicked.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Transfers user to the AdminLeaderboard page when the 'Leaderboard' button is clicked.

methods.name: selectB_Click
methods.description: Populates the course dropdown based on the selected semester, dynamically adding course options for different academic years and semesters.

methods.name: AddQB_Click
methods.description: Inserts a new theory question into the database, updates the question number, and provides user feedback.

methods.name: setB_Click
methods.description: Creates a new exam entry in the database for the selected course and informs the user.

methods.name: clearB_Click
methods.description: Clears the input text boxes for question data.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user and redirects to the login page.

methods.name: selectSemesterDropDownList_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Updates the courses dropdown list based on the selected semester, similar to selectB_Click.

methods.name: SelectCourseDropDownList_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Updates the question number textbox based on the number of existing questions for the selected course.
